newsitem.title: UK: Barings head of equity trading quits.
newsitem.headline: Barings head of equity trading quits.

text.p: ING Barings has accepted the resignation of Baring Securities head of equity trading Richard Katz, a spokeswoman for the bank said.
"His resignation has been accepted," she said in response to an inquiry from Reuters.

Sources familiar with the situation said there had been friction between Katz and the bank's new owners, ING Groep of the Netherlands and that Katz and the bank had come to an agreement over his resignation.
The spokeswoman declined to comment on market talk that Nick Cowan would succeed Katz.
"I cannot comment on the position of Mr Cowan," she said.

Katz was in large part responsible for building the equity trading division of Baring Securities and was one of the few Barings directors to survive a purge in the wake of the bank's acquisition by ING in the wake of the Nick Leeson affair, which caused Barings to collapse.
He had sat on the asset and liability committee of Barings, which was in charge of risk management.
